description: This file contains the implementation of the Lua virtual machine, including functions for type conversion, table access, arithmetic operations, and the main execution loop of the Lua interpreter.

methods.name: luaV_tonumber
methods.description: Converts a TValue to a number if possible, returning the TValue or NULL.

methods.name: luaV_tostring
methods.description: Converts a TValue to a string representation if it is a number.

methods.name: luaV_gettable
methods.description: Performs table get operation with metamethod support.

methods.name: luaV_settable
methods.description: Performs table set operation with metamethod support.

methods.name: luaV_lessthan
methods.description: Compares two TValue objects for less-than relation.

methods.name: luaV_equalval
methods.description: Checks equality of two TValue objects, considering metamethods.

methods.name: luaV_concat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple TValue objects into one string.

methods.name: luaV_execute
methods.description: Main interpreter loop executing Lua bytecode instructions.
